concerns.text: FR-001 requires acquisition of ≥ 50 paired plant species, but T001 only verifies ≥ 1 species and does not enforce the 50‑species minimum.
FR-003 mandates identification of exactly 3‑5 metabolite classes with significant negative correlation, yet T003 merely returns any classes meeting q < 0.05 without enforcing the 3‑5 range.
SC-001 measures species count against an “appropriate” target, but no task enforces a concrete numeric target (e.g., ≥ 50 species) – T001 logs N but does not compare to a defined threshold.
SC-002 expects R² > 0.3 for model performance; T004 and T006 verification commands only check R² > 0.1, so the required threshold is not validated.
SC-004 sets a VIF < 5 threshold, yet T004 only logs a warning for VIF ≥ 5 and does not treat it as a failure, leaving the requirement unenforced.
